ai-workflow-engine.description: Exposes AI-Workflow dynamic slash-command engine tools to Kiro and LLM agents

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description: Execute an AI-Workflow by file path with options, state persistence, and event logging

tools.name: workflow_probe
tools.description: Execute deterministic system, git, and toolchain environment probing with secret redaction

tools.name: workflow_inspect
tools.description: Inspect step checkpoints, events, and artifacts of a workflow run from SQLite store

tools.name: workflow_replay
tools.description: Replay or resume a workflow run from failure with zero re-token spend

tools.name: workflow_graph
tools.description: Generate static DAG graph visualization without execution (HTML, Mermaid, or ASCII)

tools.name: workflow_script_check
tools.description: Compile-check a facade script (strict TS against the workflow facade, purity bans, literal rules) and return diagnostics, phases, and the site table — without executing anything

tools.name: workflow_script_run
tools.description: Run a facade script in the sandbox (deterministic journal; --resume replays completed nodes at zero provider calls). Returns runId, status, result value, and stats (asks/replayHits).

tools.name: workflow_run_script
tools.description: Run a facade script through the sandboxed engine (journal-backed deterministic replay) and return runId, final status, per-site summaries (siteId/ordinal/status/durationMs) and stats; bounded by runTimeoutMs

tools.name: workflow_inspect_run
tools.description: Inspect a facade-script run in the journal: the dwf_runs status row, the per-site dwf_nodes table (redacted) and an evidence-ledger summary (counts and the latest entries)

tools.name: workflow_get_run
tools.description: Fetch a facade-script run's journal short-circuit statistics — total asks, replay hits, amend hits, divergences and world.run executions (same accounting as the runner stats)
